name: get_current_temperature
description: Retrieves the current ambient temperature from a specified location, such as a room, building, or outdoor environment.

required_parameters.name: location
required_parameters.description: The specified location, such as a room, building, or outdoor environment from where the current ambient temperature is to be retrieved.

result_parameters.name: temperature
result_parameters.description: The current ambient temperature at the specified location.

name: check_door_status
description: Queries the status of a door to determine if it is currently open or closed, and may provide additional security information.

required_parameters.name: door_location
required_parameters.description: The location of the door that the user wants to check the status of

result_parameters.name: door_status
result_parameters.description: The current status of the door: locked or unlocked

name: play_music
description: Initiates the playback of music on a connected audio system, including options to select playlists, songs, or streaming services.

required_parameters.name: song/playlist
required_parameters.description: The specific song or playlist that the user wants to play.

optional_parameters.name: volume
optional_parameters.description: The volume at which the music should be played.

optional_parameters.name: music_service
optional_parameters.description: The specific music or streaming service, e.g. Spotify.

optional_parameters.name: location
optional_parameters.description: The location where the user wants the music to be played.

optional_parameters.name: music_genre
optional_parameters.description: The specific genre of music the user wants to play.

result_parameters.name: confirmation
result_parameters.description: A confirmation message that the music has been played as per user's instruction.

name: lock_door
description: Commands a smart lock to secure a door, ensuring the door is locked and reporting the lock status.

required_parameters.name: door_name
required_parameters.description: The name or location of the door that needs to be locked

result_parameters.name: lock_status
result_parameters.description: The status of the door lock after the 'lock_door' action

name: adjust_room_temperature
description: Controls the thermostat or heating/cooling system to set a specific temperature for a room or area.

required_parameters.name: temperature
required_parameters.description: The desired temperature to set the thermostat or heating/cooling system to.

required_parameters.name: location
required_parameters.description: The specific room or area where the temperature should be adjusted.

result_parameters.name: confirmation
result_parameters.description: A confirmation message that the temperature has been set as per user's instruction.

name: adjust_lighting
description: Modifies the lighting conditions in a specified area, which can include dimming, color changes, or turning lights on or off.

required_parameters.name: location
required_parameters.description: Specifies the area where the lighting conditions are to be modified

required_parameters.name: action
required_parameters.description: Determines the action to be executed on the specified lighting conditions such as turning on or off lights or dimming

optional_parameters.name: intensity
optional_parameters.description: Represents the level of brightness to be set if the lights are to be dimmed or brightened

result_parameters.name: status
result_parameters.description: Returns the status of the action performed on the specified lighting conditions

name: adjust_music_volume
description: Changes the volume of the music currently being played on a connected audio system.

required_parameters.name: volume
required_parameters.description: A numerical representation of the desired music volume

result_parameters.name: confirmation
result_parameters.description: Confirmation message that the volume adjustment has been made accordingly

name: GetWeather
description: Get the weather of a certain location on a date. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: BookAppointment
description: Book an appointment at a dentist for a given time and date. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: FindProvider
description: Find a dentist by location and optionally by services offered. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: AddToPlaylist
description: This tool allows the user to add a specific song to a specified playlist.

required_parameters.name: playlist
required_parameters.description: The name of the playlist to which the user wants to add the song.

optional_parameters.name: entity_name
optional_parameters.description: The name of the song that the user wants to add to the playlist.

optional_parameters.name: artist
optional_parameters.description: The name of the artist of the song that the user wants to add to the playlist.

optional_parameters.name: music_item
optional_parameters.description: The specific music item that the user wants to add to the playlist.

optional_parameters.name: playlist_owner
optional_parameters.description: The owner of the playlist to which the user wants to add the song.

result_parameters.name: confirmation_message
result_parameters.description: A message confirming that the song has been added to the playlist.

result_parameters.name: playlist_content
result_parameters.description: The current list of songs in the playlist after the addition.

items.description: The title and artist of each song in the playlist.

name: BookRestaurant
description: This tool allows the user to make a reservation at a specified restaurant.

optional_parameters.name: poi
optional_parameters.description: The point of interest related to where the restaurant is located.

optional_parameters.name: party_size_description
optional_parameters.description: Description of the party size for the reservation.

optional_parameters.name: served_dish
optional_parameters.description: Specific dish the restaurant serves that the user is interested in.

optional_parameters.name: restaurant_name
optional_parameters.description: Name of the restaurant to make a reservation at.

optional_parameters.name: restaurant_type
optional_parameters.description: Type or style of the restaurant like Japanese, Italian, etc.

optional_parameters.name: facility
optional_parameters.description: Facilities provided by the restaurant like WiFi, parking, etc.

optional_parameters.name: spatial_relation
optional_parameters.description: The spatial or geographic relation of the restaurant in reference to another location.

optional_parameters.name: party_size_number
optional_parameters.description: Number of people included in the reservation.

optional_parameters.name: cuisine
optional_parameters.description: Type of cuisine the restaurant offers.

optional_parameters.name: country
optional_parameters.description: Country where the restaurant is located.

optional_parameters.name: sort
optional_parameters.description: Sorting order for restaurant search results.

optional_parameters.name: state
optional_parameters.description: State where the restaurant is located.

optional_parameters.name: city
optional_parameters.description: City where the restaurant is located.

optional_parameters.name: timeRange
optional_parameters.description: Desired time range for the reservation.

result_parameters.name: reservation_confirmation
result_parameters.description: A confirmation message including the reservation details.

result_parameters.name: restaurant_details
result_parameters.description: Details about the restaurant including address, contact information, and any special notes.

contact.description: The contact information for the restaurant.

special_notes.description: Any special notes or additional information about the restaurant.

name: GetWeather
description: This tool provides current, historical, or forecasted weather information based on the user's location and specified time.

optional_parameters.name: condition_description
optional_parameters.description: Descriptive phrase pertaining to weather condition

optional_parameters.name: geographic_poi
optional_parameters.description: Geographic point of interest for the weather information

optional_parameters.name: country
optional_parameters.description: Country for which the weather information is required

optional_parameters.name: condition_temperature
optional_parameters.description: Weather condition based on temperature

optional_parameters.name: spatial_relation
optional_parameters.description: Spatial relation for the given geographic point of interest

optional_parameters.name: state
optional_parameters.description: State for which the weather information is required

optional_parameters.name: city
optional_parameters.description: City for which the weather information is required

optional_parameters.name: timeRange
optional_parameters.description: Specific time range for the weather data

optional_parameters.name: current_location
optional_parameters.description: Current location of the user

result_parameters.name: temperature
result_parameters.description: The temperature at the specified location and time.

result_parameters.name: humidity
result_parameters.description: The humidity level at the specified location and time.

result_parameters.name: conditions
result_parameters.description: The weather conditions (e.g., clear, cloudy, rainy) at the specified location and time.

result_parameters.name: wind_speed
result_parameters.description: The wind speed at the specified location and time.

result_parameters.name: precipitation
result_parameters.description: The precipitation information at the specified location and time, if any.

name: PlayMusic
description: This tool allows the user to play music based on their preferences, including artist, genre, or era.

optional_parameters.name: artist
optional_parameters.description: The name of the artist whose music the user wants to play.

optional_parameters.name: album
optional_parameters.description: The name of the album from which the user wants to play music.

optional_parameters.name: music_item
optional_parameters.description: A specific music item that the user wants to play.

optional_parameters.name: track
optional_parameters.description: A specific track number that the user wants to play from an album.

optional_parameters.name: year
optional_parameters.description: The year of release for the music that the user wants to play.

optional_parameters.name: genre
optional_parameters.description: The genre of music that the user wants to play.

optional_parameters.name: service
optional_parameters.description: The music streaming service that the user wants to use to play music.

optional_parameters.name: sort
optional_parameters.description: The order in which the user wants to sort the music in the playlist.

optional_parameters.name: playlist
optional_parameters.description: The name of a pre-existing playlist that the user wants to play.

result_parameters.name: playlist
result_parameters.description: A playlist containing the selected music based on user's preferences.

items.description: The title and artist of each song in the playlist.

name: SearchScreeningEvent
description: This tool allows the user to search for screening events such as movies, plays, or performances.

optional_parameters.name: object_location_type
optional_parameters.description: Defines the type of the location where the screening event is held.

optional_parameters.name: movie_name
optional_parameters.description: The name of the movie or performance.

optional_parameters.name: location_name
optional_parameters.description: The name of the place where the event is screened.

optional_parameters.name: object_type
optional_parameters.description: Specifies the category of the screening event (movie, play, performance).

optional_parameters.name: timeRange
optional_parameters.description: The range of time during which the event is screened.

optional_parameters.name: spatial_relation
optional_parameters.description: The relational context of the location where the event is screened.

optional_parameters.name: movie_type
optional_parameters.description: The type/genre of the movie or performance.

result_parameters.name: screening_events
result_parameters.description: A list of screening events available based on the user's search criteria.

items.description: The title and screening times of each event.

name: SearchCreativeWork
description: This tool allows the user to search for creative works such as movies, TV shows, music albums, books, or video games. It takes the name of the creative work as a required parameter and optionally, the type of the creative work. It returns information about the searched creative work, including details such as availability, platforms, genre, and purchase options.

required_parameters.name: object_name
required_parameters.description: The name of the creative work to be searched.

optional_parameters.name: object_type
optional_parameters.description: The type of the creative work to be searched. It could be a movie, TV show, music album, book, or video game.

result_parameters.name: creative_work_info
result_parameters.description: Information about the searched creative work, including details such as availability, platforms, genre, and purchase options.

name: RateBook
description: This tool allows users to rate books or other literary works.

required_parameters.name: rating_value
required_parameters.description: The rating value provided by a user for a particular book or literary work.

optional_parameters.name: object_name
optional_parameters.description: The name or the title of the book or the literary work.

optional_parameters.name: object_select
optional_parameters.description: The specific object in the literary work that the rating is associated with.

optional_parameters.name: object_type
optional_parameters.description: The type or the category of the book or the literary work.

optional_parameters.name: rating_unit
optional_parameters.description: The unit or scale in which the rating is given.

optional_parameters.name: best_rating
optional_parameters.description: The best or maximum rating that can be given to a book or a work of literature.

optional_parameters.name: object_part_of_series_type
optional_parameters.description: Indicating whether the literary work is part of a series and, if so, the type of that series.

result_parameters.name: user_review
result_parameters.description: The user's review of the book or literary work, including the rating, review text, reviewer name, and review date.

optional_parameters.name: depart_date
optional_parameters.description: Departure date.

optional_parameters.name: depart_time
optional_parameters.description: Departure time.

optional_parameters.name: arrive_date
optional_parameters.description: Arrival date.

optional_parameters.name: arrive_time
optional_parameters.description: Arrival time.

optional_parameters.name: airline_name
optional_parameters.description: The name of airline.

result_parameters.name: flight_details
result_parameters.description: Flight details including flight number, departure, destination, date, departure time, arrival time, cabin class, and price.
